references.text: God answers Moses' prayer by letting him see the land from the top of Pisgah, but denies him permission to cross the Jordan
Moses sees the promised land from Mount Nebo, including Lebanon, before he dies - the fulfillment of God's answer to Moses' prayer
God commands Moses to go up on Mount Abarim to see the land, because he will not be allowed to enter it
Moses explains that the Lord was angry with him and swore that he would not cross the Jordan or enter the good land
Description of the good land on the other side of the Jordan that Moses longs to see
God's promise of a good and vast land, the same land Moses asks to be allowed to see
Moses tells that the Lord was also angry with him for the people's sake and said he would not enter the land
